lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Hello! I am Gus. I am a <color=red>gardener</color>.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Oh no! I lost some <color=red>words</color> from my story about a pumpkin. Can you put them back?

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Pick the word that fits each gap. Fill all five gaps and the library gets five new books!

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 1:
I plant a tiny seed in the <color=red>_____</color>.
lines.hint: Not quite. Read the sentence again. Where do seeds go?
lines.correctText: I plant a tiny seed in the <color=red>soil</color>.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 2:
Rain falls, and the seed starts to <color=red>_____</color>.
lines.hint: Not quite. What do seeds do?
lines.correctText: Rain falls, and the seed starts to <color=red>grow</color>.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 3:
The sun is warm and <color=red>_____</color>.
lines.hint: Not quite. How does the sun look?

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 4:
Soon, a big orange <color=red>_____</color> sits in my garden.
lines.hint: Not quite. What grows from a seed and is big and orange?
lines.correctText: Soon, a big orange <color=red>pumpkin</color> sits in my garden.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 5:
I cut it up and make a yummy <color=red>_____</color>.
lines.hint: Not quite. What can you eat?
lines.correctText: I cut it up and make a yummy <color=red>soup</color>.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: You found all five <color=red>words</color>! Thank you. Five new books are going to the library!

afterLines.speaker: Gus
afterLines.text: Thank you for helping with my story. Go and see the new <color=red>books</color>!
